## Tag `ucglef1-v1.0.0`
`golden.lock` records `ucglef1_freeze_commit: "ucglef1-v1.0.0"` (a tag name, no SHA). The freeze commit is the one that wrote `physics_dir_hash: 42805c73…92dd` into the lock: `git log -S'42805c73…' -- backend/audit/golden.lock` → `73ae381` ("chore(reconcile): execute PROMPT 0 v2 — freeze migration…"). Verified: `backend/audit/physics` exported at `73ae381` hashes to `42805c73538df5eb0f9eb109ead9a541253d5371d71eac5ea04be0ffaf8e92dd` (dirhash sha256, ignores `*.pyc`, `__pycache__`, `.pytest_cache`, `golden.lock`).
An annotated tag was created locally at `73ae38142ae936fa1aeecf1f842dc34d234369d4`. `git push origin refs/tags/ucglef1-v1.0.0` fails three times with "the remote end hung up unexpectedly", while branch pushes succeed. The session's git proxy refuses tag refs. The GitHub tools available here can't create tag refs either.
**James:** `git tag -a ucglef1-v1.0.0 73ae38142ae936fa1aeecf1f842dc34d234369d4 -m "UCGLE-F1 v1.0.0 freeze" && git push origin ucglef1-v1.0.0`.

## Supabase variables
- `.env` (Supabase URL, project id and publishable key, both plain and `VITE_`-prefixed) is removed from the tree (`git rm --cached`; the local copy stays so `bun run dev` keeps working). `.gitignore` now ignores `.env` and `.env.*` except `.env.example`.
- `.env.example` lists every variable the frontend, Worker and Python code reads, with names only.
- R9 degrade: `src/integrations/supabase/{client,client.server}.ts` no longer throw when variables are missing. They return `unconfiguredClient` (`src/integrations/supabase/unconfigured.ts`), which warns `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:<VAR>` once and resolves every query or auth call as a supabase-js `{ data, error }` failure, with no default project. `auth-middleware.ts` answers 503 `BLOCKED-ON-JAMES:<VAR>` instead of 500. Unit tests: `src/integrations/supabase/__tests__/unconfigured.test.ts` (2 tests).
